title: AI Model Profiles Configuration
summary: This module defines specific model profiles for various AI providers and models, configuring their capabilities like tool support, JSON output, and thinking mechanisms. It adapts base profiles from different providers to suit specific integration requirements.

nodes.label: Generate Groq Model Profile
nodes.title: Configure Groq Model Profile
nodes.description: Defines specific capabilities and settings for Groq models, including web search and thinking support based on the model name.

nodes.label: Generate Harmony Model Profile
nodes.title: Configure Harmony Model Profile
nodes.description: Adapts an OpenAI model profile for the OpenAI Harmony Response format, disabling tool choice requirements and handling streamed whitespace.

nodes.label: Generate Bedrock Amazon Profile
nodes.title: Configure Bedrock Amazon Profile
nodes.description: Generates a model profile for Amazon models accessed via Bedrock, adding tool choice support, prompt caching, and specific native tools for 'nova-2' models.

nodes.label: Generate Groq MoonshotAI Profile
nodes.title: Configure Groq MoonshotAI Profile
nodes.description: Extends a MoonshotAI model profile with JSON object and schema output support when used with the Groq provider.

nodes.label: Generate Meta Groq Model Profile
nodes.title: Configure Meta Groq Profile
nodes.description: Provides a model profile for Meta models used with the Groq provider, conditionally enabling JSON object/schema output for specific models.

nodes.label: Generate OpenRouter Google Profile
nodes.title: Configure OpenRouter Google Profile
nodes.description: Retrieves a Google model profile and applies a specific JSON schema transformer for compatibility with OpenRouter's translation layer.

nodes.label: OpenAI Base Profile
nodes.title: Base OpenAI Model Profile
nodes.description: A foundational model profile for OpenAI models, used as a starting point for Harmony configurations.

nodes.label: Amazon Base Profile
nodes.title: Base Amazon Model Profile
nodes.description: A foundational model profile for Amazon models, used as a starting point for Bedrock configurations.

nodes.label: MoonshotAI Base Profile
nodes.title: Base MoonshotAI Model Profile
nodes.description: A foundational model profile for MoonshotAI models, extended for Groq provider usage.

nodes.label: Meta Base Profile
nodes.title: Base Meta Model Profile
nodes.description: A foundational model profile for Meta models, extended for Groq provider usage.

nodes.label: Google Base Profile
nodes.title: Base Google Model Profile
nodes.description: A foundational model profile for Google models, adapted for OpenRouter access.

nodes.label: Configured Model Profile
nodes.title: Resulting Model Profile
nodes.description: The final, configured ModelProfile object containing specific capabilities and settings for an AI model.

nodes.label: Code Execution Tool
nodes.title: Native Code Execution Tool
nodes.description: A native tool representing the capability to execute code, which can be supported by certain models like Bedrock's Nova-2.

nodes.label: OpenRouter JSON Transformer
nodes.title: OpenRouter JSON Schema Transformer
nodes.description: A specific JSON schema transformer used to ensure compatibility with OpenRouter's translation layer for Google models.

groups.label: Groq Provider Profiles
groups.title: Groq Provider Model Profiles
groups.description: Functions that define or adapt model profiles specifically for models accessed through the Groq provider, including MoonshotAI and Meta models.

groups.label: Other Provider Profiles
groups.title: Other Provider Model Profiles
groups.description: Functions that define or adapt model profiles for various other AI providers like Harmony (OpenAI), Bedrock (Amazon), and OpenRouter (Google).
